--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,31 @@
+import asyncio
+from fastapi import FastAPI, APIRouter
+
+async def startup_handler():
+    print("Startup handler called")
+    startup_handler.called = True
+
+startup_handler.called = False
+
+async def shutdown_handler():
+    print("Shutdown handler called")
+    shutdown_handler.called = True
+
+shutdown_handler.called = False
+
+router = APIRouter(on_startup=[startup_handler], on_shutdown=[shutdown_handler])
+app = FastAPI()
+app.include_router(router)
+
+async def main():
+    # Simulate FastAPI startup and shutdown
+    async with app.router.lifespan_context(app):
+        print("Inside lifespan")
+    
+    print(f"Startup handler called: {startup_handler.called}")
+    print(f"Shutdown handler called: {shutdown_handler.called}")
+    assert startup_handler.called, "Startup handler was not called"
+    assert shutdown_handler.called, "Shutdown handler was not called"
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    asyncio.run(main())
